The '''TKR-R treatment chamber''' was manufactured during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era. When activated, it closed and healed the user.

==Behind the scenes==
The TKR-R treatment chamber is a regeneration item that was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.4.2 on [[October 29]], [[2013]]. Decorated like a jack-o-lantern, the chamber is named after the traditional Halloween saying "trick or treat," and was a special Halloween-themed item that was only available until [[November 5]].<ref name="2.4.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.4.2/10292013|text=Game Update 2.4.2 Patch Notes}}</ref>
